data.description:
# C — Un-defer Serena's symbol tools so the good default costs no discovery step

## Context / Problem

The single mechanism most directly responsible for the observed failure was **friction asymmetry**, not missing
guidance. In the session that prompted this epic, `Bash` was already loaded and in active use for `rebar` and
`pytest`, while Serena's symbol tools were **deferred** — their schemas were not loaded, so using them required
an extra `ToolSearch` round-trip first. `grep` cost zero extra steps; Serena cost one discovery step plus
unfamiliar parameters. Under that gradient the cheaper tool wins whatever the documentation says.

Removing the asymmetry attacks the cause rather than the symptom: if `find_referencing_symbols` is as immediate
as `grep`, the documented preference becomes the path of least resistance instead of an uphill one.

## Approach

Configure this repo's sessions so the small set of Serena symbol tools is available without a discovery step:
`find_symbol`, `find_referencing_symbols`, `get_symbols_overview` (and `find_declaration` if cheap). Keep the
set deliberately SMALL — Serena exposes many tools and loading them all would spend context on capabilities that
are not the bottleneck. The three navigation tools are the ones the guidance actually names.

**Tradeoff, stated:** always-loaded schemas cost context in every session, including sessions that never
navigate code. The bet is that three tool schemas are cheaper than the class of defect caused by hand-enumerated
references (which in epic `061c` cost a full-suite pre-flight failure and several remediation cycles). If that
bet looks wrong in practice, this is trivially reversible — it is configuration, not code.

## Scope

- The repo's MCP/tool configuration (e.g. `.mcp.json` / `.claude/settings.json`) — mark the chosen Serena symbol
  tools as non-deferred for this project.

## Testing

- In a FRESH session in this repo, `find_referencing_symbols` is callable as the first tool use, with no
  preceding `ToolSearch`.
- Tools deliberately left deferred stay deferred (the set did not silently expand).

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] in a fresh session, `find_referencing_symbols` is invocable with no preceding `ToolSearch`, evidenced by a
      transcript
- [ ] the always-loaded set is limited to the navigation tools named in `AGENTS.md` (<= 4), and the story records
      which tools were chosen and why
- [ ] the change is configuration only, with a one-line note on how to revert it
data.title: C — Un-defer Serena symbol tools so the good default costs no discovery step
